description: Fork of exp760 (E=192 hard 24K = 1.2048 @ 176M). Limit-test tiny variant: E 192->96, d_v 32->16, ALL tphs halved (qkv/v 256->128, out 512->256, resid 256->128, emb_resid 256->128). NAPs: qkv=4, v=6, out=6 (was 7), resid=5 (was 6), emb_resid=5 (was 6) — shrunk further to push into ~50M zone. Same hard+dense_K recipe, bf16 LUT storage + fp32 master Lion + global clip(1.0). bs=48 phys * grad_accum=2 = eff bs=96 (matching exp720's data regime, 2x exp760's eff bs=48). 24K steps -> 1.18B tokens (2x exp760). Goal: deployment-quality SOTA at ~50M params (vs exp760 176M, exp720 84.94M).
